content.title: 3 Restaurant Stocks We Steer Clear Of
content.summary: From fast food to fine dining, restaurants play a vital societal role. But the side dish is that they’re quite difficult to operate because high inventory and labor costs generally lead to thin margins at the store level. This leaves little room for error if demand dries up, and it seems like the market has some reservations as the industry has tumbled by 5.9% over the past six months. This drop is a stark contrast from the S&P 500’s 11.1% gain.
